text:
All right, mate! You’ve got both the Grass Badge
and the Water Badge by now, right?\c
In that case, we’re both headed for Motostoke
and the Fire Gym Leader, Kabu![VAR 0114(0005)]

How about I share with you a little tip about
that Leader Kabu?\c
From what I heard, he’s holed up now in Galar
Mine No. 2, undergoing some special training![VAR 0114(0005)]

If he’s in there, then we can’t take him on in
Motostoke even if we zip right over there—
putting the brakes on our Gym Challenge.\c
So I say we head to Galar Mine No. 2 ourselves!
Let’s go see what all the fuss is about![VAR 0114(0005)]
